description: Global TreeFrogUI content manager profile manifest — declarative, versioned, device-independent

treefrogui_compatibility.evidence: README.md ROM folder setup table (tzubertowski/treefrog-ui main), docs/standalone-apps.md, cores.md, sdcard/cubegm/frogui/settings.txt, lgpt-r36sx-port sd_root verification

notes: Folder mappings, media destinations and BIOS rules must live in declarative profiles — never hardcoded in UI code (device-independence invariant). Profiles are loaded via serde in Rust backend and mirrored in Python domain for tests.
